newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-SOUTH AFRICA DROP FRESH FACES FOR ZAMBIA CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUTH AFRICA DROP FRESH FACES FOR ZAMBIA CLASH.

text.p: South African coach Clive Barker has dropped seven players for Sunday's World Cup qualifier against Zambia in the wake of the defeat by the Netherlands on Wednesday.
Barker named a 24-man squad for the group three qualifier in Johannesburg but left out most of the new faces he introduced against the Dutch.
South Africa fielded a new-look selection in the friendly on Wednesday with an eye to identifying new players for the national team but there were few highlights for Barker as his side lost 2-0.
Barker reverted to almost the same squad that travelled to England last month, where the South Africans lost 2-1 in Manchester in another warm-up international.
He added strikers Mark Williams and Pollen Ndlanya and dropped reserve forward George Koumantarakis for Sunday's game.
Goalkeepers - Mark Anderson (Umtata Bucks), Andre Arendse (Cape Town Spurs), Brian Baloyi (Kaizer Chiefs).
Defenders - Mark Fish (Lazio, Italy), Sizwe Motaung, David Nyathi (both Tenerife, Spain), Andrew Rabutla (Jomo Cosmos), Lucas Radebe (Leeds United, England), Neil Tovey (Kaizer Chiefs).

Midfielders - Linda Buthelezi (Mamelodi Sundowns), Doctor Khumalo (Columbus Crew, U.S.), Clinton Larsen (Manning Rangers), Thomas Madigage (Supersport United), Helman Mkhalele, John Moeti (both Orlando Pirates), John Moshoeu (Kocaelispor), Dumisa Ngobe (Orlando Pirates), Eric Tinkler (Cagliari, Italy).

Strikers - Brendan Augustine (Linzer ASK, Austria), Shaun Bartlett (Colorado Rapids, U.S.), Phil Masinga (Salernitana, Italy), Pollen Ndlanya (Bursaspor, Turkey), Jerry Sikhosana (Orlando Pirates), Mark Williams (Kaizer Chiefs).
